description: Manifests that break a rule about bytes: the version, the shortest form of a varint, the tags and the end of the bytes. Each has one fault in an otherwise valid manifest, and `rule` is the rule of SPEC.md section 8 it breaks.

cases.name: version 0
cases.reason: version is not 1

cases.name: version 2
cases.reason: version is not 1

cases.name: version 65535
cases.reason: version is not 1

cases.name: version 1 in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint with a zero byte too many, for the version

cases.name: version past 16 bits
cases.reason: a varint that does not fit a u16

cases.name: a version and nothing else
cases.reason: an unknown version is refused before anything after it is read

cases.name: entry count 0 in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint with a zero byte too many, for the count

cases.name: path length in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint with a zero byte too many, for the path length

cases.name: size in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint with a zero byte too many, for the size

cases.name: mtime_ms in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint with a zero byte too many, for mtime_ms

cases.name: mode in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint with a zero byte too many, for the mode

cases.name: loc tag in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint with a zero byte too many, for the loc tag

cases.name: pack_index in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint with a zero byte too many, for pack_index

cases.name: link_target length in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint with a zero byte too many, for the length of link_target

cases.name: pack count in two bytes
cases.reason: a varint with a zero byte too many, for the pack count

cases.name: a size of eleven bytes
cases.reason: a varint longer than 10 bytes

cases.name: a size over 64 bits
cases.reason: a varint that does not fit a u64

cases.name: a mode over 32 bits
cases.reason: a varint that does not fit a u32

cases.name: a pack_index over 32 bits
cases.reason: a varint that does not fit a u32

cases.name: kind 3
cases.reason: a kind that is not 0, 1 or 2

cases.name: kind 255
cases.reason: a kind that is not 0, 1 or 2

cases.name: loc tag 3
cases.reason: a loc tag that is not 0, 1 or 2

cases.name: link_target tag 2
cases.reason: an Option tag that is neither 0 nor 1

cases.name: link_target tag 255 on a symlink
cases.reason: an Option tag that is neither 0 nor 1

cases.name: a path that is not UTF-8
cases.reason: a lone 0xFF byte in the path

cases.name: a path with an overlong UTF-8 form
cases.reason: 0xC0 0x80 is an overlong NUL

cases.name: a path with a surrogate in UTF-8
cases.reason: UTF-8 may not encode U+D800

cases.name: a link_target that is not UTF-8
cases.reason: 0xC3 0x28 is not a UTF-8 sequence
